items.title: John Pope Interview, 1959-05-01
items.q: the Excelsior Band was practically born, you understand, on the day that I was born. And I was getting together. My father and his friends. And they organized a band and named it the Excelsior Band

ctx.x: 1883, November 23rd. So you're 76 years old. 76 years old, this year. Now, as I'm saying, the Excelsior Band was practically born, you understand, on the day that I was born. And I was getting together. My father and his friends. And they organized a band and named it the Excelsior Band, you see.
Why did they choose Excelsior as a name? I don't know. But it was in honor of your birth. That's right.
Your father was Alexander Pope. That's right. John Alexander Pope.
